headline: Crude Oil Climbs on Prospects of U.S. Military Action Against Iran
summary: Oil prices gained following the prospect of fresh U.S. military action against Iran, raising concerns over potential disruptions to Middle Eastern crude supplies.
why: Iran is a prominent OPEC producer situated along critical energy transit chokepoints, making tensions with the U.S. a key driver of crude risk premiums.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Expectations of military conflict involving a major Middle Eastern oil exporter prompt risk premiums in crude benchmarks.
